params.display_name: Define and map DS4-native GLM 5.2 TP4 shard layout

overall_semantic.overview: Each rank memory maps only its Q/head, expert, vocab, and layer shard files and records its owned spans.

architecture_rationale.value: The DS4-native layout is a separate child graph because file format, tensor ownership, and mmap rules are the load-bearing decisions hidden by the parent mapper action.

semantics.value: Consumes d-shard-manifest.
Produces d-loaded-rank-shard.
